claims.text: At 2:47:06 in the same episode Pines said Steinman's text refers to Wang's boss only as 'H-A-K', and that he himself concluded 'oh, Henry A. Kissinger'. Pines states the identification as his own inference from the initials, not as something Steinman wrote. Any Wang-to-Kissinger link would rest on that inference and on nothing else.

claims.text: On American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 15 November 2024, at 2:46:17, Matthew Pines named the source of the Wright-Patterson story about Wang: a book by the UFO researcher William Steinman on the 1948 Aztec crash, which Pines says describes 'Eric Henry Wang' as head of special projects at Wright-Patterson who came over with Operation Paperclip. This identifies the single secondhand source behind the story the board's existing caution declines.
